descriptionChirho: Haphel (Hifil) of Aramaic שְׁכַח: to find, discover, or locate something through active searching or encounter; used in Daniel and Ezra for finding evidence, persons, or facts.
Hitpeel (Hitpael) of Aramaic שְׁכַח: passive sense indicating that something was found, discovered, or shown to exist; often used of guilt, fault, or records being found upon examination.
